'''Marko''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. He carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], [[Knife/Legends|knife]] and [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]]. Marko was able to speak [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]], and was skilled in the operation of an [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] [[A-24 Sleuth-class scout ship|A-24 Sleuth]].<ref name="Live-Action Adventures" />

==Behind the scenes==
Marko was the example character used in ''[[Live-Action Adventures]]'' to describe how to create a character and play the game.<ref name="Live-Action Adventures" />
